title: NH-66 stretch in Keralam being developed as the first e-truck corridor in country

title: 'No complaint, no insult': MP denies nod to prosecute BJP neta for Col Qureshi remarks
content: In a decisive move, the Madhya Pradesh government has crafted a five-point reply to present to the Supreme Court concerning minister Kunwar Vijay Shah’s controversial comments. The state cabinet has opted not to grant sanction for his prosecution, noting the absence of any complaints against him. They assert that he neither specified any officer nor failed to apologize.

title: 'I'm surprised': American GM after Pragg wins India's historic GCT title | Exclusive
content: American Grandmaster Levon Aronian has revealed how Praggnanandhaa turned a weakness he identified last year into a strength, helping the Indian grandmaster win the Grand Chess Tour (GCT) Finals. Aronian, who had beaten Praggnanandhaa in GCT Finals last year, praised the youngester's progress and fighting spirit while admitting he was surprised by how quickly the Indian closed that gap.

title: ‘AAP burning with anger’: Raghav Chadha's name 'shifted' from Punjab draft SIR
content: Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha alleges political vendetta by the Punjab AAP government. His name was marked as 'shifted' in the state's draft electoral roll. Chadha states his voter ID is registered in Mohali, Punjab. He is pursuing remedies during the ongoing claims and objections process. Final electoral rolls will be published in October 2026.

title: Read Mayor Mamdani's statement as New York bans AI in school
content: New York City schools are placing strict limits on artificial intelligence use for students. Younger students face the most significant restrictions, with AI banned until high school. High school students will have limited AI access for specific educational purposes. Teachers can use AI for lesson planning and translation tasks. Centrally approved instructional programs and assistive technologies are exempt from these new rules.

title: Ram Temple Trust inducts 3 new trustees, elevates Govind Giri as general secretary
content: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has inducted three new trustees. Swami Govind Dev Giri was elevated to general secretary while Mahesh Bhagchandka became treasurer. Bhagchandka brings business and philanthropic experience to the expanded governing body. Madan Mohan Pandey and Dr Nirmala Yadav also joined the trust's board. These appointments fill all vacant positions and strengthen the trust's administrative framework.

title: Months after Dell's $6.25 billion pledge, Trump Accounts get new rules
content: New guidelines from the Treasury have made it easier for employers to contribute to Trump Accounts for children's savings. Each employer can offer up to $2,500 tax-free per year for employees' dependents, while employees themselves can also make pre-tax payroll contributions. This initiative builds on a generous $6.25 billion commitment from the Michael and Susan Dell Foundation, with over fifty companies already joining this important child savings program.

title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for today - check list
content: Top stock market recommendations: Bank of Maharashtra, Glenmark Pharma, and Tata Technologies have been shared as the top stocks to buy today on September 3, 2026 by Aakash K Hindocha, Vice President - Research, Nuvama Professional Clients Group/Nuvama Wealth.

title: Gurugram teen's AI app screens 1,650 villagers after grandma's eye illness
content: Siddhartha Manaktala, at just 17 years old, has developed EyeSpy, an innovative AI smartphone app tailored for eye disease screening. In rural Haryana, he has successfully screened over 1,650 individuals, many of whom were previously unaware of their vision problems. With enhancements from the L V Prasad Eye Institute, EyeSpy now identifies seven eye diseases and operates offline on basic smartphones.

title: 7-year-old falls in skating race, then stages epic comeback
content: During a spirited skating competition, young Tangtang faced a setback by falling right from the start. Demonstrating remarkable perseverance, she rose swiftly and began to pursue her fellow competitors, ultimately securing the lead. This inspiring recovery serves as a crucial reminder for parents on teaching their children resilience. Failures are an undeniable part of life, and guiding children in navigating these difficult moments is essential.

title: Former Ukrainian defence minister launches Palantir-backed defence tech firm
content: Palantir's chief executive, Alex Karp, has stepped into the role of principal investor for an innovative defense tech firm established by former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov. This enterprise's mission is to leverage Ukraine's battlefield expertise, transforming wartime knowledge into advanced technology solutions for Ukraine and its allies, drawing from the real-life experiences of the ongoing conflict against Russia.

title: Kiyosaki’s billion-dollar debt: How 'Rich Dad Poor Dad' author treats leverage as ‘good debt’
content: Robert Kiyosaki perceives his significant debt as a tactical resource for wealth generation. He utilizes borrowed capital to purchase income-producing real estate, positioning this strategy against the typical mindset of debt avoidance. By securing his debt against properties and collaborating with partners, Kiyosaki promotes the informed application of debt as a formidable financial instrument.

title: Peruvian tennis player registers 1st US Open win 68 years after grandfather's last victory
content: The 22-year-old, seeded 32nd, defeated American Marcos Giron 3-6, 6-3, 6-3, 6-7(6), 6-1 in a match that lasted three hours and 48 minutes on Court Six.

title: LeBron James’ $25.5m foundation faced criticism: Why did Akron’s school spark questions?
content: LeBron James' foundation is dedicated to empowering youth in Akron by providing crucial education and life skills programs. Recently, the I PROMISE School faced challenges due to unsatisfactory state test outcomes. Yet, amidst the critique, the foundation remains steadfast in its support for students and their families. A new collaboration with Nike introduces swimming lessons, focusing on building confidence and enriching life experiences beyond academics.

title: Travis Kelce’s $1.5m charity under scrutiny: Why did less go to charity?
content: Travis Kelce’s Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation is facing scrutiny over its reported spending between 2021 and 2024. The nonprofit raised $1.5 million and spent about $1.1 million, with $469,000 listed for management and $446,000 for charity. Kelce’s business manager Aaron Eanes disputed the figures, saying some charitable operational costs were misclassified. He said management fees dropped to zero in 2025 as the foundation works to improve transparency and governance.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $2.75M community impact: How is he giving back to Kansas City?
content: The Patrick Mahomes Foundation has made a significant impact in Kansas City by distributing nearly $2.75 million in grants. A notable achievement includes a $1 million investment in the Martin Luther King Jr. Park. Additionally, the foundation has provided countless meals and free eye exams for families. Their '15 for 15' program creates valuable opportunities for underserved youth, ensuring Mahomes leaves a meaningful legacy in the community.

title: 'Look at what the rankings were before': PCB chief Naqvi hits back at critics
content: Pakistan Cricket Board Chairman Mohsin Naqvi defended sweeping Test squad and coaching changes after Pakistan’s heavy 2-0 series loss to England. Seven players were dropped and five uncapped players added, while Mike Hesson and Ashley Noffke took coaching roles. Despite criticism from former cricketers and fans, Naqvi called the decisions "essential" and defended his record, highlighting progress in white-ball cricket.

title: Donald Trump reacts to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s UK move
content: In a recent statement, Donald Trump commented on the return of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle to Britain, stating his discontent as he wouldn't have welcomed them back. Trump, who fondly recalled his relationship with Queen Elizabeth and King Charles, criticized the couple for their perceived disrespect toward the royal family, declaring that had he been in a royal position, their return would not have been acceptable.

title: BCCI to discuss Rohit's future in key meet, 2027 ODI WC roadmap also on agenda
content: Stalwart’s career, ODI team and the team’s poor performances in Ireland and England to be discussed as Indian cricket’s top brass meets on September 3 in Mumbai.

title: Oil price today: Crude continues to trade beyond $95 per barrel
content: Oil prices took a minor dip on Thursday following a turbulent trading day. Investors are closely monitoring the repercussions of the US-Iran strikes on oil supply lines. Activity in the Strait of Hormuz is currently lower than average. This disruption fosters worries regarding global oil availability and possible price hikes as countries explore alternative sources while depending on diminishing reserves.

title: ‘FIDE must punish players’: Hans slams Russia No. 1 Nepo over comments on 14-yo
content: American chess grandmaster Hans Niemann urged FIDE to punish players for publicly making accusations, especially involving young competitors. His comments came after Ian Nepomniachtchi questioned a move by 14-year-old Canadian IM Aaron Mendes during their Titled Tuesday game. Nepomniachtchi described the move as suspicious, while Mendes went on to win after Nepomniachtchi’s blunder and eventual resignation.

title: Op Sindoor commander Jeetendra Mishra selected as Ayodhya Ram temple’s first CEO
content: Jeetendra Mishra, a retired Air Marshal, has been appointed as the first CEO of the Ram temple trust. He previously led India's western air operations during the historic Operation Sindoor in 2025. Mishra is expected to leverage his extensive skills in organizational leadership and operational planning. The selection process was rigorous, involving thousands of applicants, with the trust now poised to outline the CEO’s responsibilities.

title: 11 coaches in 5 years: Inside Pak cricket’s never-ending coaching carousel
content: Pakistan cricket has struggled with ongoing coaching instability, marked by numerous changes and management reshuffles since September 2021. The Pakistan Cricket Board has tried various structures and roles for senior management, leading to short-lived appointments of prominent figures like Jason Gillespie and Gary Kirsten. This unpredictable pattern underscores a long-standing challenge within the sport, raising questions about the team's direction and consistency.

title: After Hanuman Ansh, 5 Neem Karoli Baba teachings that feel more relevant than ever
content: Neem Karoli Baba's insights continue to hold significant importance in today's world. His guidance highlights the necessity of spiritual advancement amidst daily obligations. Followers learned to channel anger productively and engage positively in conflicts. Prioritizing service to others was fundamental, showcasing spirituality through tangible actions. The art of living with diminished ego and attachment serves as a meaningful lesson for all.

title: Toxic box office day 8: Yash film drops 35%, earns Rs 5.1cr

Its domestic total has now reached two hundred thirty-four point seven zero crore net.  Worldwide gross collection for 'Toxic' crossed three hundred twenty-two crore on day eight.  Kannada screenings recorded the strongest audience occupancy among major language versions.

title: Yolo meets SIP: How Gen Z is rewriting money rules & mistakes they should avoid

title: Nitin Gadkari urges all state governments to allow bike taxis

This new system will lead to license suspension and cancellation for offenders.  A pilot program for driver medical diagnosis was also launched.  This initiative aims to improve road safety and worker well-being.

title: 'November is a priority’: Trump aides push to contain Iran war until midterm elections

Recent exchanges of strikes have increased tensions between the US and Iran. Military readiness and depleted munitions stockpiles also constrain White House strategy. America's Gulf allies are urging the White House to de-escalate the conflict.

title: 'New peaks of lethality': IAF tests Khagantak-243; all about long range glide bomb
content: The Indian Air Force has achieved a major milestone by successfully testing the Khagantak-243 glide bomb. This homegrown weapon enhances India's stand-off precision strike capability, covering distances of over 140 km once released from an aircraft. Developed in partnership by Bharat Electronics Limited and JSR Dynamics, this test underscores India's commitment to defence innovation.

title: China's Xi tells Middle East to be ‘masters of their own destiny’ amid Iran war
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping urged Middle Eastern nations to resist external interference.  He called for reshaping the region's security order during talks with Egypt's President Sisi.  Both leaders agreed to deepen security and economic cooperation between their nations.  China seeks to expand its influence and safeguard vital shipping routes.  Egypt is diversifying its international partnerships by strengthening ties with Beijing.

title: Subhash Chandra questions validity of 'faulty & wrong' NCLT order
content: subhash Chandra alleged the tribunal did not have the power to constitute a five-member special bench . he questioned the validity of the order before NCLAT . the tribunal barred him from alienating any of his property and stayed its order .

title: Govt bodies differ, Centre to test green crackers afresh
content: centre Wednesday told the supreme court it intended to conduct fresh tests to assess the harmful impact of the use of barium . centre asked CSIR-NEERI to develop green/low-emission fireworks - with particulate matter emission reduction of more than 50% - in association with manufacturers .

title: SC: BCI chair's tenure is for 2 years, can't be made 5 years by own resolution
content: the petitioners questioned the lavish spending of crores on felicitation functions, organising seminars and alleged misuse of trust funds to open law colleges in states . the bench of chief justice Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said no resolution can override the statutorily prescribed two-year term .

title: 2 killed, multiple injured in Minneapolis apartment shooting
content: the shooting was reported at around 5.45 pm (local time) after which dozens of police vehicles and officers surrounded the area . the area around the scene includes an apartment complex, the Minneapolis Convention Center, hotels and a hospital .

title: No role in Sarla Bhat killing, but give me death sentence: Yasin Malik
content: jammu Kashmir Liberation Front chairman Yasin Malik has denied any role in the killing of Kashmiri Pandit nurse Sarla Bhat . in the affidavit, malik also talks about divorcing his wife to spare her the life of a widow and seeks capital punishment for himself . malik has been in new Delhi’s Tihar jail since 2019 .

title: CBI probe necessary into Disha Salian's death: HC
content: HC directed CBI to file an FIR and probe the case thoroughly . no one is to be named as an accused without sufficient grounds, HC clarified . the death of celebrity manager disha Salian had "many glaring discrepancies"

title: In times of reels, Centre plans 'social media code' for officers
content: centre is likely to come up with a "social media code of conduct" for its officers . prime minister modi has directed top bureaucrats to explore the possibility of bringing out the code . the proposal is significant, as in many cases, officers through social media posts glorify their work and position .

title: 60 targets struck, 18m barrels cross Hormuz: Inside US military’s record day in Iran
content: the operation comes amid growing risks for commercial shipping . the high-risk operation came as US forces struck nearly 60 Iranian military targets . escorted vessels carrying around 18 million barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz .

title: US judge partially halts Trump’s latest birthright citizenship order
